 Join BMW TechWorks Romania on our journey of innovation and excellence as we redefine the future of motion, one product at a time. Our engineers are vital to the innovation and digitalization of BMW Group's driving machines, production, sales and banking processes, and you could be part of our evolving teams.
 What Awaits You
As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will be responsible for the administration, configuration, and operational support of the enterprise security solutions used in the BMW Group. These solutions include endpoint detection and response, endpoint protection, encryption, system hardening, and privileged access management.
Your role will focus on ensuring security platforms are correctly deployed, available, up to date, and operating as intended while also supporting incident investigations and maintaining security configurations.
You will be in close contact and cooperation with the respective product teams in the areas of Hardware Devices, Industrial Devices and more, both in German-speaking countries and internationally.
You are responsible for the further development (roadmaps) and consolidation of the solutions used based on strategic guidelines.
You manage commissioned providers with global operational responsibility, both in terms of content and financially.
 What Should You Bring Along
University Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field
Minimum 3-5 years of experience working in a similar role
Infrastructure knowledge: on-prem, windows server, virtualization, monitoring, backup, log analysis, networking, troubleshooting
Cybersecurity knowledge: firewall, encryption, vulnerabilities, VPN, MFA, public wi-fi networks
Collaboration Skills: experience working in agile/SCRUM teams using Atlassian tools (Confluence, Jira)
Scripting knowledge: PowerShell, automation
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus
